tagline: Navigate Montreal's winter, one better step at a time.

demo.banner: Demo mode — everything on this site comes from labelled test fixtures. Nothing reflects real conditions in Montréal.

desc.confirmed: Official or verified observation from a cited source.
desc.unverified_report: A 311 request or community report. Not confirmed by anyone.
desc.model_estimate: Output of a validated model or a labelled heuristic. An estimate, not an observation.
desc.unknown: No data. Unknown is never treated as zero risk.
desc.simulated: Demo-only data. Not a real observation.

states.error: Something went wrong while loading this.
states.staleDesc: Last refreshed more than 6 hours ago.
states.offline: You appear to be offline. Data shown may be out of date.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This path doesn't exist. It may have moved.

backend.waking: The server is waking up. This public demo runs on a free plan that sleeps when idle, so the first request can take about a minute. Retrying automatically…

writesDisabled.title: Not available in this public demo
writesDisabled.reports: Sending winter reports is turned off in this public demo, so nothing would be stored. The planner, winter conditions and data pages work as usual.
writesDisabled.pilot: Pilot requests can't be sent from this public demo, so nothing would be stored. The rest of the site works as usual.
